descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B19 · 已排除（票还在 in progress / ready for pr（Quinn 10-14：不计入 bug 数））· 原 P1

保留 / 清理没有按 UAT 3.6 实现：13 小时的重点事项、37 小时的任务 / 交接 / 体征都还在；医生不打开 app 就不清；超过 500 个病人时会漏清

票：TFA-94699 in progress · 算 QA bug：否（票在做） · 在哪发现：本地

注：一个根因让 19 条用例都挂了；保留时长本身怎么定，见待决策 D6

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

思路 / Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S17 「大规模清除：一个账号 501 份病历，同时 20 个账号，全部调到 37 h」 Purge at scale: 501 charts on one account and 20 accounts at once, all aged 37 h

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T2 The purge runs on the server: records clear at their window whether or not any device has the app open.（TFA-94699 AC 7；UAT 3.7 (retention claim)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Records clear exactly at their window: each item is still present just before its window ends and gone just after it.（UAT OAT-04 Expected 1；TFA-94699 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：性能（performance） — 量时间，看是不是在要求的秒数里。

Given One physician with 501 synthetic Hospital patients and 20 physicians with 50 each; every chart's vitals, labs and medication rows aged 37 h. Controls: 10 of the 20 accounts and chart #501 of the large account also hold fresh items (vitals recorded 1 h ago, an open task on a chart processed 2 h ago)

When One purge cycle runs (the server job; on main the client-called applyLifecycle)

Then Every aged item on every chart is gone after one cycle, including chart #501; every control item is still there; each applyLifecycle call (or the server job) returns without throwing and the local Convex log has no read/write-limit error; the cycle time is recorded

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Completeness from OAT-04 Expected 1 and TFA-94699 AC 7: any chart still holding aged data after the cycle (or after the agreed lag, Q1) = Fail; chart #501 holding aged data after one cycle = Fail; any control item missing = Fail (deleted too early or on the wrong account); a thrown call or a limit error in the local Convex log = Fail. …

在哪跑：本地 retention（改时钟看保留期）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（blocked）

S17 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94699 in progress

一个账号有 501 个病人时，一轮清理会漏掉第 501 个病历，它 37 小时的化验和用药行要等下一轮才清。

With 501 patients on one account, one purge pass leaves the 501st chart's 37 h-old labs and medication rows in place until another pass.

依据：allure 8cd2bac5-…-result.json; retention lane, isolated backend. 5 checks pass, 2 fail, known K13 (applyLifecycle reads at most 500 charts per call). Time is recorded only (2.4 s for the large account).

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane retention。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：PERF · 性能计时 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：retention。
